Gravebound Brooch

You fasten the cold brooch and feel its chill linger against your skin.

Rules

ID: item-gravebound-brooch. Status: Proposal — special equipment. Form: Brooch. Bulk: 1.

Requirements: No discipline requirement; understanding not required. Action: Passive unless the effect says otherwise.

Life resistance 1 while worn. Reduces both Life damage and Life healing; minimum 1 still applies.

Apply this item’s printed benefit only; it grants no ability or action beyond what it states. No DP purchase; found or bought when the DA makes it available. No special recipe is supplied by owning it.

Equipment index

Market price: 180 coins (special-order benchmark; availability is not guaranteed). Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
